title: With Switch 2, iPhone, and laptop tricks, the Sharge Disk Pro 2 is finally a worthy EDC

paragraphs.text: One portable magnetic USB-C-to-HDMI dock to rule them all?
paragraphs.translation: 一款磁吸式的 USB-C 轉 HDMI 多功能底座，能否稱霸全場？

paragraphs.text: Sharge, the company that makes delightful retro Mac-shaped chargers and see-inside batteries, is finally impressing me with a portable SSD. I couldn’t recommend the Sharge Disk, Disk Plus, or even the Disk Pro, but I’d be happy to own the new Disk Pro 2 Ultra.
paragraphs.translation: Sharge 這家公司以推出設計精巧、復古 Mac 造型的充電器及透明外殼電池聞名，而這次他們終於用一款可攜式 SSD 讓我刮目相看。我原本無法推薦 Sharge Disk、Disk Plus，甚至是 Disk Pro，但我很樂意擁有一台新的 Disk Pro 2 Ultra。

paragraphs.text: This isn’t just a drive. It’s a 4K HDMI dock and a USB-C hub too. It’s a veritable USB-C Swiss Army Knife for all your main gadgets: laptop, tablet, phone, Steam Deck, even the Nintendo Switch and Switch 2.
paragraphs.translation: 這不只是一個硬碟，它同時也是一個 4K HDMI 擴充塢與 USB-C 集線器。對於你所有的主力裝置——筆記型電腦、平板、手機、Steam Deck，甚至是 Nintendo Switch 和 Switch 2 來說，它簡直是 USB-C 界的「瑞士刀」。

paragraphs.text: And this USB multitool has built-in MagSafe pattern magnets to stick it to your iPhone, Pixel, or anything where you’re willing to stick a magnetic ring. (One stick-on ring is included.)
paragraphs.translation: 這款 USB 多功能工具內建了 MagSafe 規格的磁鐵，可以吸附在你的 iPhone、Pixel，或任何你願意貼上磁環的裝置上。（產品內附一個貼片磁環。）

paragraphs.text: In total, this pack-of-playing-cards-sized gadget adds one 4K 144Hz HDMI 2.1 video output, a 5Gbps USB-A port, SD and microSD card readers, plus USB-C passthrough charging — plus a slot to add up to 8TB of solid-state storage with a full-sized M.2 2280 (or smaller M.2 2242 and 2230) stick SSDs.
paragraphs.translation: 總結來說，這個尺寸僅如一副撲克牌的小裝置增加了：一個 4K 144Hz HDMI 2.1 影片輸出埠、一個 5Gbps USB-A 埠、SD 與 microSD 讀卡機、以及 USB-C 供電傳輸功能——此外還有一個插槽，可放入全長尺寸的 M.2 2280（或較小的 M.2 2242 與 2230）固態硬碟，提供最高達 8TB 的儲存空間。

paragraphs.text: By plugging in a single cord, I gave my MacBook Pro a second external monitor, four simultaneous sources of storage (SSD, USB flash drive, SD, microSD), and 80W of USB-C PD juice.
paragraphs.translation: 只要插上一條線，我就能讓我的 MacBook Pro 擁有第二台外接顯示器、四個同步儲存來源（SSD、USB 隨身碟、SD、microSD），以及 80W 的 USB-C PD 電力支援。

paragraphs.text: And when I plugged in my Android phone and a USB-C iPhone, both of them saw the SSD and showed up on my HDMI screen. It also unlocked 4K60 ProRes video recording on the iPhone… more on that in a minute.
paragraphs.translation: 當我插上我的 Android 手機和 USB-C iPhone 時，兩者都能偵測到 SSD 並且在我的 HDMI 螢幕上顯示畫面。它甚至解鎖了 iPhone 上的 4K60 ProRes 錄影功能……這點稍後詳談。

paragraphs.text: Some of these features exist together in other gadgets, and this 10Gbps external SSD enclosure certainly isn’t the fastest in town now that 40Gbps and 80Gbps enclosures exist. With big 100GB and 195GB transfers, my write speeds with a budget 1TB Lexar NM710 in the Disk Pro 2 averaged around 700MB/s.
paragraphs.translation: 雖然有些功能也存在於其他裝置中，且考慮到市面上已有 40Gbps 和 80Gbps 的硬碟外接盒，這款 10Gbps 的外接盒肯定不是目前最快的。在傳輸 100GB 和 195GB 的大型檔案時，使用平價的 1TB Lexar NM710 裝在 Disk Pro 2 裡，我的平均寫入速度約為 700MB/s。

paragraphs.text: But that’s still nothing to sneeze at, and how many enclosures double as USB-C HDMI docks, let alone ones that speak Nintendo’s language and magnetically attach to your phone? How many have a built-in fan to keep them cool? And how many are low-power enough that you can power the HDMI and USB ports from your phone or laptop, no need for a power cord?
paragraphs.translation: 但這速度仍是不容小覷的，而且有多少外接盒能兼任 USB-C HDMI 擴充塢，更別提還支援任天堂系統且能磁吸在手機上的？有多少內建風扇來散熱？又有多少功耗低到可以僅靠手機或筆電帶動 HDMI 和 USB 埠，而不需要額外插電源線？

paragraphs.text: Things get a little tricky with the low wattage, though.
paragraphs.translation: 不過，在低瓦數運作下，情況會變得有點複雜。

paragraphs.text: First, Sharge is selling two models of the Disk Pro 2, the “Ultra” that requires at least 1.5W of USB-C bus power, and and the “Lite” which needs 5W for its more power-hungry chips (and only does 4K60 over HDMI 2.0, instead of 4K144 over HDMI 2.1).
paragraphs.translation: 首先，Sharge 販售兩種型號的 Disk Pro 2：一種是需要至少 1.5W USB-C 匯流排供電的「Ultra」版；另一種是「Lite」版，其耗電量較高的晶片需要 5W（且 HDMI 2.0 僅支援 4K60，而非 HDMI 2.1 的 4K144）。

paragraphs.text: Second, to achieve such low power draw on the Ultra, it can only route 3W of power from your laptop or phone to a connected SSD, Sharge marketing manager Leo H. tells me. Reviews show my borrowed Lexar NM710 draws more than that during writes — and sure enough, the Disk Pro 2 shut down right after I started ProRes video recording on an iPhone 15 Pro or a big transfer on my Galaxy S25.
paragraphs.translation: 第二，Sharge 的行銷經理 Leo H. 告訴我，為了讓 Ultra 版達成如此低的功耗，它從筆電或手機引導至連接 SSD 的電力僅有 3W。測試顯示我借來的 Lexar NM710 在寫入時的功耗超過此數值——果不其然，當我在 iPhone 15 Pro 上開始 ProRes 錄影，或在 Galaxy S25 上進行大型檔案傳輸時，Disk Pro 2 就斷電關機了。

paragraphs.text: (There’s a simple solution: just plug an external USB-C battery or charger into the Disk Pro 2. When I did that, I recorded over five minutes of 4K60 ProRes video, no problem. You could instead try to find a lower-power SSD.)
paragraphs.translation: （有個簡單的解決方案：只要將外接 USB-C 行動電源或充電器插進 Disk Pro 2 即可。當我這樣做時，錄製超過五分鐘— 4K60 ProRes 影片完全沒問題。或者你也可以嘗試找一款功耗較低的 SSD。）

paragraphs.text: Third, while the HDMI dock does work with both my Switch 2 and my original Switch, Nintendo’s handhelds explicitly check for a relatively specific external power source before docking. Sharge is still tweaking the firmware, but says I currently need a 85W or higher USB-C PD charger plugged in for Switch 2 in particular.
paragraphs.translation: 第三，雖然 HDMI 擴充塢確實能搭配我的 Switch 2 和原版 Switch 使用，但任天堂的手持裝置在進入底座模式前，會明確檢查是否連接了特定規格的外接電源。Sharge 仍在調整韌體，但表示目前特別針對 Switch 2，我需要插上 85W 或更高功率的 USB-C PD 充電器。

paragraphs.text: You should also know there’s a long pause before the Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 appear on a connected TV, like some other third-party docks, and you won’t get variable refresh rate (VRR) with a Steam Deck or other PC handhelds. It does 4K144 and 4K120 with HDR, but the Steam Deck claims my VRR TV is not VRR-capable with the Disk Pro 2 as a go-between.
paragraphs.translation: 你也應該知道，在連接電視後，畫面要過好一陣子才會出現在 Nintendo Switch 或 Switch 2 上，就像其他副廠擴充塢一樣，而且搭配 Steam Deck 或其他掌機時無法獲得可變刷新率（VRR）。它支援 4K144 和 4K120 HDR，但 Steam Deck 顯示我的 VRR 電視在透過 Disk Pro 2 轉接時不具備 VRR 功能。

paragraphs.text: And while I successfully worked with a mouse, keyboard, headset, monitor, webcam, and more plugged into the Disk Pro 2 for several days — by daisy-chaining an extra USB hub — I did occasionally see the monitor go dark for a minute, roughly once a day.
paragraphs.translation: 雖然我成功地在 Disk Pro 2 上插著滑鼠、鍵盤、耳機、螢幕、視訊鏡頭等裝置工作了好幾天——透過串接另一個 USB 集線器——但我確實偶爾會遇到螢幕黑掉約一分鐘的情況，大概一天發生一次。

paragraphs.text: There’s still work for Sharge to do. But it’s the first drive from the company that I’d happily add to my go bag.
paragraphs.translation: Sharge 還有進步空間。但這是該公司第一款讓我願意放進隨身包的硬碟。

paragraphs.text: The original Sharge Disk was a bulky dongle with a ridiculously noisy tiny fan. The Disk Plus marketed itself as barely-there stylishly thin SSD enclosure that magnetically attaches to your phone, but the magnets were actually a stick-on accessory that made the drive much thicker. The first Sharge Disk Pro had a power port so tiny and recessed that most charging cables wouldn’t fit, and buttons that could actually cut power to the drive mid-transfer.
paragraphs.translation: 第一代 Sharge Disk 是一個笨重的轉接器，配有一個吵死人的微型風扇。Disk Plus 主打超薄時尚、可磁吸手機的硬碟盒，但磁鐵其實是貼上去的配件，讓硬碟厚度大增。第一代 Sharge Disk Pro 的電源孔深陷且窄小，多數充電線都插不進去，按鈕甚至可能在傳輸中途切斷硬碟電源。

paragraphs.text: The Disk Pro 2 fixes all that. The included cable is now detachable, the magnets are built-in, the ports are no longer weirdly recessed, the fan isn’t noisy by default, you can turn off that fan entirely, the switch doesn’t cut power to the drive, and the drive has a larger airflow path. Plus, you can bring your own SSD — though I’d prefer toolless swaps to the current screws.
paragraphs.translation: Disk Pro 2 修正了這一切。附贈的線材現在是可拆卸的，磁鐵改為內建，連接埠不再深陷，風扇預設不再吵鬧，且可以完全關閉風扇，開關不會誤切電源，且通風路徑更大。此外，你可以自備 SSD——雖然我更希望是免工具拆裝而非現在的螺絲固定。

paragraphs.text: You won’t always see much higher transfer speeds turning that fan on full blast. My 195GB transfer took 4 minutes and 55 seconds with the fan on full power, and 5 minutes 5 seconds with it off — a difference of just 10 seconds, even though I let it cool between tests. The real difference is the one I felt when trying to pick up the Disk Pro 2 afterwards. Without fan, the metal sides were burning hot to the touch.
paragraphs.translation: 把風扇開到最強並不總是能看到極高的傳輸速度。我的 195GB 傳輸在風扇全開時耗時 4 分 55 秒，關閉時為 5 分 5 秒——僅差 10 秒，儘管我在測試間隔讓它降溫了。真正的差別在於事後拿起 Disk Pro 2 的手感：沒開風扇時，金屬側面燙得嚇人。

paragraphs.text: The Disk Pro 2 Ultra is $75 on Kickstarter for early bird and will be $89 full retail. While the typical caveats apply with Kickstarter projects, Sharge has a very solid track record for shipping (even if it’s hit and miss on design).
paragraphs.translation: Disk Pro 2 Ultra 在 Kickstarter 上的早鳥價為 75 美元，正式零售價將為 89 美元。雖然 Kickstarter 專案通常需注意風險，但 Sharge 在出貨方面紀錄良好（即使設計水準偶爾不穩）。

paragraphs.text: More in: It’s clearly time: all the news about the transparent tech renaissance
paragraphs.translation: 更多內容見於：顯然時候到了：關於透明科技復興的所有新聞。
